content.value_statement: Medical device teams need structured audit plans, findings, and CAPA follow-up. This skill guides ISO 13485 audit planning, execution, reporting, and external audit preparation.
actual_capabilities: Guides risk-based ISO 13485 internal audit program planning.
Outlines audit preparation, execution, reporting, and follow-up workflows.
Supports nonconformity classification and CAPA verification planning.
Helps prepare for regulatory, certification, and customer audits.
Defines auditor competency areas and development criteria.
Suggests audit program metrics and continuous improvement practices.
limitations: It does not replace a qualified auditor or regulatory advisor.
It needs organization-specific procedures, records, and risk data.
It does not validate evidence or confirm actual compliance.
Referenced automation scripts are described, not implemented in this package.

use_cases.title: Build an Annual Audit Program
use_cases.description: Create a risk-based internal audit schedule that covers critical ISO 13485 processes and follow-up needs.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Audit Checklist
use_cases.description: Draft process audit questions, evidence requests, and reporting sections for a selected QMS area.

use_cases.title: Coordinate External Audit Readiness
use_cases.description: Plan readiness checks, staff roles, document access, and response steps before an external assessment.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Audit Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an ISO 13485 internal audit plan for [process]. Include scope, criteria, schedule, roles, and evidence to review.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Process Audit Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a process audit checklist for [QMS process]. Include audit questions, objective evidence, ISO 13485 links, and expected records.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Nonconformities and CAPA
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these audit findings: [findings]. Classify each issue, explain the rationale, and suggest CAPA verification activities.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Risk-Based Audit Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a risk-based annual ISO 13485 audit program using these process risks, past findings, complaints, and regulatory changes: [details].

output_examples.input: Create an audit plan for purchasing controls at a medical device company.
output_examples.output: A concise plan with scope, audit criteria, process owner interviews, supplier file sampling, evidence requests, timing, and follow-up actions.

output_examples.input: Classify three audit findings and suggest CAPA verification steps.
output_examples.output: A finding table in plain language with major or minor classification, evidence basis, likely risk, and verification activities.

output_examples.input: Prepare for an ISO 13485 certification body audit next month.
output_examples.output: A readiness checklist covering internal audit closure, management review status, staff roles, document access, and response discipline.

best_practices: Provide process scope, applicable clauses, recent audit history, and known risks.
Ask for evidence-based outputs that separate facts, assumptions, and recommendations.
Have a qualified quality professional review outputs before official use.
anti_patterns: Do not use generated findings without objective evidence from actual records.
Do not treat this skill as legal, regulatory, or certification authority advice.
Do not enter confidential patient, employee, or supplier data unless approved.

faq.question: What standard does this skill focus on?
faq.answer: It focuses on ISO 13485 quality management system audits for medical device organizations.

faq.question: Can it create audit checklists?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft process-based checklists with audit questions, evidence requests, and clause references.

faq.question: Can it replace a certified auditor?
faq.answer: No. It supports planning and documentation, but qualified professionals must make audit judgments.

faq.question: Does it run audit automation scripts?
faq.answer: No. The package describes possible scripts, but only placeholder script content is included.

faq.question: Is it useful for external audits?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help prepare readiness checks, roles, document access, and response workflows.

faq.question: What inputs produce the best results?
faq.answer: Use process names, applicable requirements, risk levels, past findings, complaints, and available records.
